OpenAI-compatible pay-per-use, EU-sovereign (DE). 2026-09-08: Qwen3.8-27B added (marked New on the USD price page); Llama 3.1 8B removed from both the USD and EUR price tables (docs list it as retiring 2026-10-15, successor Qwen3.5-9B). No proprietary frontier models (GPT-6, Claude, Grok, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3, MiniMax M3, DeepSeek V4) — IONOS hosts open-weight EU-sovereign models only. 7 LLMs + 1 VLM + 1 code model.
